-P PREROUTING ACCEPT
-P INPUT ACCEPT
-P FORWARD ACCEPT
-P OUTPUT ACCEPT
-P POSTROUTING ACCEPT
-N RRDIPT_INPUT
-N RRDIPT_OUTPUT
-N mwan3_connected_ipv4
-N mwan3_custom_ipv4
-N mwan3_dynamic_ipv4
-N mwan3_hook
-N mwan3_iface_in_dial0
-N mwan3_iface_in_dial1
-N mwan3_iface_in_dial2
-N mwan3_iface_in_dial3
-N mwan3_iface_in_dial6
-N mwan3_ifaces_in
-N mwan3_policy_md_balanced
-N mwan3_policy_wan_only
-N mwan3_rule_md_intra0
-N mwan3_rule_md_intra1
-N mwan3_rule_md_svc
-N mwan3_rules
-A PREROUTING -j mwan3_hook
-A INPUT -j RRDIPT_INPUT
-A OUTPUT -j RRDIPT_OUTPUT
-A OUTPUT -j mwan3_hook
-A RRDIPT_INPUT -i eth0 -j RETURN
-A RRDIPT_INPUT -i tun0 -j RETURN
-A RRDIPT_INPUT -i br-lan -j RETURN
-A RRDIPT_INPUT -i eth1 -j RETURN
-A RRDIPT_OUTPUT -o eth0 -j RETURN
-A RRDIPT_OUTPUT -o tun0 -j RETURN
-A RRDIPT_OUTPUT -o br-lan -j RETURN
-A RRDIPT_OUTPUT -o eth1 -j RETURN
-A mwan3_connected_ipv4 -m set --match-set mwan3_connected_ipv4 dst -j MARK --set-xmark 0x3f00/0x3f00
-A mwan3_custom_ipv4 -m set --match-set mwan3_custom_ipv4 dst -j MARK --set-xmark 0x3f00/0x3f00
-A mwan3_dynamic_ipv4 -m set --match-set mwan3_dynamic_ipv4 dst -j MARK --set-xmark 0x3f00/0x3f00
-A mwan3_hook -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -j CONNMARK --restore-mark --nfmask 0x3f00 --ctmask 0x3f00
-A mwan3_hook -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -j mwan3_ifaces_in
-A mwan3_hook -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -j mwan3_custom_ipv4
-A mwan3_hook -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -j mwan3_connected_ipv4
-A mwan3_hook -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -j mwan3_dynamic_ipv4
-A mwan3_hook -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -j mwan3_rules
-A mwan3_hook -j CONNMARK --save-mark --nfmask 0x3f00 --ctmask 0x3f00
-A mwan3_hook -m mark ! --mark 0x3f00/0x3f00 -j mwan3_custom_ipv4
-A mwan3_hook -m mark ! --mark 0x3f00/0x3f00 -j mwan3_connected_ipv4
-A mwan3_hook -m mark ! --mark 0x3f00/0x3f00 -j mwan3_dynamic_ipv4
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial0 -i dial0 -m set --match-set mwan3_custom_ipv4 src -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment default -j MARK --set-xmark 0x3f00/0x3f00
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial0 -i dial0 -m set --match-set mwan3_connected_ipv4 src -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment default -j MARK --set-xmark 0x3f00/0x3f00
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial0 -i dial0 -m set --match-set mwan3_dynamic_ipv4 src -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment default -j MARK --set-xmark 0x3f00/0x3f00
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial0 -i dial0 -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment dial0 -j MARK --set-xmark 0x100/0x3f00
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial1 -i dial1 -m set --match-set mwan3_custom_ipv4 src -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment default -j MARK --set-xmark 0x3f00/0x3f00
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial1 -i dial1 -m set --match-set mwan3_connected_ipv4 src -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment default -j MARK --set-xmark 0x3f00/0x3f00
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial1 -i dial1 -m set --match-set mwan3_dynamic_ipv4 src -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment default -j MARK --set-xmark 0x3f00/0x3f00
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial1 -i dial1 -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment dial1 -j MARK --set-xmark 0x200/0x3f00
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial2 -i dial2 -m set --match-set mwan3_custom_ipv4 src -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment default -j MARK --set-xmark 0x3f00/0x3f00
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial2 -i dial2 -m set --match-set mwan3_connected_ipv4 src -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment default -j MARK --set-xmark 0x3f00/0x3f00
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial2 -i dial2 -m set --match-set mwan3_dynamic_ipv4 src -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment default -j MARK --set-xmark 0x3f00/0x3f00
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial2 -i dial2 -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment dial2 -j MARK --set-xmark 0x300/0x3f00
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial3 -i dial3 -m set --match-set mwan3_custom_ipv4 src -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment default -j MARK --set-xmark 0x3f00/0x3f00
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial3 -i dial3 -m set --match-set mwan3_connected_ipv4 src -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment default -j MARK --set-xmark 0x3f00/0x3f00
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial3 -i dial3 -m set --match-set mwan3_dynamic_ipv4 src -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment default -j MARK --set-xmark 0x3f00/0x3f00
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial3 -i dial3 -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment dial3 -j MARK --set-xmark 0x400/0x3f00
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial6 -i dial6 -m set --match-set mwan3_custom_ipv4 src -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment default -j MARK --set-xmark 0x3f00/0x3f00
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial6 -i dial6 -m set --match-set mwan3_connected_ipv4 src -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment default -j MARK --set-xmark 0x3f00/0x3f00
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial6 -i dial6 -m set --match-set mwan3_dynamic_ipv4 src -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment default -j MARK --set-xmark 0x3f00/0x3f00
-A mwan3_iface_in_dial6 -i dial6 -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment dial6 -j MARK --set-xmark 0x500/0x3f00
-A mwan3_ifaces_in -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -j mwan3_iface_in_dial3
-A mwan3_ifaces_in -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -j mwan3_iface_in_dial2
-A mwan3_ifaces_in -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -j mwan3_iface_in_dial6
-A mwan3_ifaces_in -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -j mwan3_iface_in_dial1
-A mwan3_ifaces_in -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -j mwan3_iface_in_dial0
-A mwan3_policy_md_balanced -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m statistic --mode random --probability 0.20000000019 -m comment --comment "dial6 1 5" -j MARK --set-xmark 0x500/0x3f00
-A mwan3_policy_md_balanced -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m statistic --mode random --probability 0.25000000000 -m comment --comment "dial3 1 4" -j MARK --set-xmark 0x400/0x3f00
-A mwan3_policy_md_balanced -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m statistic --mode random --probability 0.33300000010 -m comment --comment "dial2 1 3" -j MARK --set-xmark 0x300/0x3f00
-A mwan3_policy_md_balanced -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m statistic --mode random --probability 0.50000000000 -m comment --comment "dial1 1 2" -j MARK --set-xmark 0x200/0x3f00
-A mwan3_policy_md_balanced -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment "dial0 1 1" -j MARK --set-xmark 0x100/0x3f00
-A mwan3_policy_wan_only -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -m comment --comment "dial0 1 1" -j MARK --set-xmark 0x100/0x3f00
-A mwan3_rule_md_intra0 -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -j mwan3_policy_md_balanced
-A mwan3_rule_md_intra0 -m mark ! --mark 0xfc00/0xfc00 -j SET --del-set mwan3_rule_ipv4_md_intra0 src,src
-A mwan3_rule_md_intra0 -m mark ! --mark 0xfc00/0xfc00 -j SET --add-set mwan3_rule_ipv4_md_intra0 src,src
-A mwan3_rule_md_intra1 -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -j mwan3_policy_md_balanced
-A mwan3_rule_md_intra1 -m mark ! --mark 0xfc00/0xfc00 -j SET --del-set mwan3_rule_ipv4_md_intra1 src,src
-A mwan3_rule_md_intra1 -m mark ! --mark 0xfc00/0xfc00 -j SET --add-set mwan3_rule_ipv4_md_intra1 src,src
-A mwan3_rule_md_svc -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -j mwan3_policy_md_balanced
-A mwan3_rule_md_svc -m mark ! --mark 0xfc00/0xfc00 -j SET --del-set mwan3_rule_ipv4_md_svc src,src
-A mwan3_rule_md_svc -m mark ! --mark 0xfc00/0xfc00 -j SET --add-set mwan3_rule_ipv4_md_svc src,src
-A mwan3_rules -d 203.0.113.79/32 -p tcp -m mark --mark 0x0/0x3f00 -j mwan3_policy_wan_only
